_comment: Suites excluded from `yarn test:ci` (WP-A8). Every entry failed on the Track A baseline of 2026-09-23, before any Track A change touched it.
Remove an entry when its suite is fixed; add one only with a reason and an issue link. `yarn test` still runs everything.
This ledger is for suites that are broken. Suites that need live infrastructure are not broken and do not belong here - they are listed in test/integrationSuites.js and excluded by jest.config.ts.
A suite can be both integration and broken; it is then listed here and in test/integrationSuites.js. Remove this entry as soon as the suite passes.
